title: Abandon a memory request or entry
goal: Record an explicit human abandon of a memory request or entry as a terminal ledger marker; never a physical delete. Boundary: this is the F1(ii) explicit human entrypoint — the F1(i) automatic lineage path (3 accumulated ingest rejections) does not pass through this action or MCP.

request.description: Request id to abandon (request scope). Mutually exclusive with --entry (enforced by the handler).

entry.description: Entry id to abandon (entry scope). Mutually exclusive with --request (enforced by the handler).

submissionCriteria: exactly one of request or entry is provided
the referenced request or entry exists in the memory registry
